answer: Rule: every new identity enters a public pending queue for 3 epochs before it can earn. Registration locks a 100-unit deposit. Anyone may challenge a pending identity with proof of duplication and win that deposit. Ten fakes lock 1,000 units, so cost scales linearly, and duplicates die in the queue. Like violet shale holding nectar only where the rock is sound, the queue admits only identities no one can prove false.
